- [《Dreams of Violets》影评：AI电影麻木但令人警醒](https://variety.com/2026/film/reviews/dreams-of-violets-review-ash-koosha-tribeca-festival-1236784209/)
- [Tom Holland：AI不具创造力，人类体验是护城河](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/tom-holland-ai-artists-human-1236784500/)
- [Jay Leno：Joe Rogan是新一代Johnny Carson，传统深夜秀已死](https://deadline.com/2026/06/jay-leno-interview-death-of-late-night-youtube-john-oliver-1236957608/)
- [Sabrina Carpenter限制令：stalker自称“拯救世界”](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/sabrina-carpenter-restraining-order-granted-testimony-1235579785/)
- [Peter Thiel秘密社团Dialog曝光好莱坞名流](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/hollywood-peter-thiel-secret-society-1236624737/)
欧美市场的技术争议与权力暗网正在重塑行业信任格局，而雷打不动的传统IP（如《Austin Powers 4》的粉丝呼声）仍维持着怀旧红利。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment industry is grappling with technological disruption, security vulnerabilities, and shifting power structures. AI's role in filmmaking dominates, while a high-profile stalking case and a secretive networking society reveal the undercurrents of Hollywood. The late-night TV format is declared obsolete by its former king.

- **AI film 'Dreams of Violets' divides critics**: the Iranian protest drama, made entirely with AI, is called 'startling but numbing'. Tom Holland counters that AI lacks soul. The debate affects how studios and unions approach AI. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/reviews/dreams-of-violets-review-ash-koosha-tribeca-festival-1236784209/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/tom-holland-ai-artists-human-1236784500/)
- **Sabrina Carpenter's restraining order** highlights a disturbing trend: the alleged stalker claimed a 'classified military program'. The judge's order suggests a real threat. [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/sabrina-carpenter-restraining-order-granted-testimony-1235579785/)
- **Jay Leno's take on the death of late-night** is the most definitive: he credits Joe Rogan's podcasts as the new talk show. This reinforces the shift of ad dollars and audience from linear TV to digital. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/jay-leno-interview-death-of-late-night-youtube-john-oliver-1236957608/)
- **Peter Thiel's secret society Dialog** includes prominent Hollywood names – a sign of growing cross-sector influence between tech, politics, and entertainment. [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/hollywood-peter-thiel-secret-society-1236624737/)
- **Knicks accept White House invitation** – owner James Dolan confirms, breaking a pattern of political avoidance by recent champions. The move will spark debate in sports and entertainment circles. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/knicks-trump-white-house-visit-1236958741/)

**Signal**: The tech-celebrity convergence is accelerating; expect more explicit alignments between Hollywood talent and Silicon Valley power players in closed-door settings.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块今日以官方背书与剧集预热为主。Stray Kids Felix被韩国文化部选为“2026韩服Wave”代言人，标志着韩流明星成为国家文化外交名片。演员Go Youn Jung在ASEA 2026获奖并接受《@style》专访，事业处于上升期。动作剧《Agent Kim Reactivated》发布新预告，So Ji Sub饰演的隐退特工父亲形象引发期待。新人男团AMPERS&ONE宣布九月启动欧洲巡演，K-pop全球化进一步向欧洲渗透。
- [Felix被任命为2026韩服Wave宣传大使](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848530wpp/stray-kids-felix-chosen-by-korean-government-as-face-of-2026-hanbok-wave)
- [Go Youn Jung ASEA获奖专访](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848423wpp/go-youn-jung-talks-about-her-wins-at-asea-2026-recent-projects-and-more)
- [《Agent Kim Reactivated》新预告：So Ji Sub为救女儿重操旧业](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848519wpp/watch-so-ji-sub-revives-his-deadly-past-to-find-his-missing-daughter-in-agent-kim-reactivated)
- [AMPERS&ONE欧洲巡演官宣](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848510wpp/ampersone-announces-stops-for-born-to-define-in-europe)
韩娱本周未出现重大争议，各家稳扎稳打推进作品与活动，Felix的政府合作案例值得关注后续商业转化效果。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment continues its global expansion with K-drama news and K-pop tours. Stray Kids' Felix gets a government endorsement, signaling soft-power strategy. New drama teasers and actor interviews suggest a busy second half of 2026.

- **Felix named '2026 Hanbok Wave' ambassador** by the Ministry of Culture – a strategic move linking K-pop to traditional Korean fashion, likely boosting tourism and cultural exports. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848530wpp/stray-kids-felix-chosen-by-korean-government-as-face-of-2026-hanbok-wave)
- **Go Youn Jung discusses ASEA 2026 wins** – the rising actress reflects on her projects. The awards held in Japan underscore cross-border K-content popularity. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848423wpp/go-youn-jung-talks-about-her-wins-at-asea-2026-recent-projects-and-more)
- **'Agent Kim Reactivated' teaser drops** – So Ji Sub returns as a deadly dad in an action revenge drama based on a popular webtoon. A strong IP pipeline continues. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848519wpp/watch-so-ji-sub-revives-his-deadly-past-to-find-his-missing-daughter-in-agent-kim-reactivated)
- **AMPERS&ONE announces European tour dates** – starting in Berlin Sept 14, covering 6 cities. K-pop's European reach expands beyond BTS and Blackpink. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848510wpp/ampersone-announces-stops-for-born-to-define-in-europe)
- **'Fifties Professionals' behind-the-scenes** – Shin Ha Kyun, Heo Sung Tae, Oh Jung Se in an action-comedy about middle-aged men. The drama targets the older demographic. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848342wpp/fifties-professionals-reveals-behind-the-scenes-photos-of-shin-ha-kyun-heo-sung-tae-oh-jung-se-and-more)

**Signal**: Government endorsement of K-pop idols for traditional culture could become a template for other nations, while European K-pop tours indicate deepening fandom beyond Asia.

微博社区动态.zh:

中国.zh:
中国娱乐产业今日以迪丽热巴为绝对焦点，兼有国际电影节和产业数字化动态。迪丽热巴亮相“中国影视之夜”压轴红毯，一袭玫红礼裙获全网好评；同期她为《利剑·玫瑰》三个月特训的幕后故事被广泛传播，塑造“女性既是利剑也是玫瑰”的刚柔并济形象。上海国际电影节“一带一路”电影周首创产业日，60余家中外机构洽谈，朱亚文、江疏影担任推广大使，凸显中国电影对外合作意图。科技层面，智象未来等大模型公司在上影节抢镜，探讨AI对电影制作的渗透；腾讯云与儒意电影合作探索影院Agent提效，传统院线数字化转型加速。
